_comment_units: Every slope rule MUST declare "unit": "percent" or "ratio". Required, not optional - a missing unit is a hard load error. It stops a 3:1 ratio being typed into a percent field and read as 3%. Percent is normal here; ratio is accepted and converted. The values below are the tool's conservative defaults - edit them to your jurisdiction and set lastVerifiedDate.

driveAisleOrRoad.notes: EDIT ME. Drive aisles and local roads.

drivewayApproach.notes: EDIT ME. Driveway approach from ROW to property line.

_comment_ada: The three accessible-surface fields are OPTIONAL. Include one only to make ADA STRICTER for this jurisdiction. A value looser than the ADA legal max (parking 2%, route running 5%, route cross 2%) is rejected at load. Omit (leave null) to use ADA as-is.
_comment_ratios: Embankment and wall-trigger values are true H:V ratios: 3.0 means 3:1. Not percent, not rise/run.
